## Plan
Built out the Cake Co ordering site: public catalog with customization, cart/checkout, order history, and a staff admin for managing cakes and order status.

## Files
39 files added/changed — pages for home/shop/product/cart/checkout/orders/account/admin/signin, `lib/` auth+db+session+orders+cakes helpers, `scripts/migrate.mjs` schema, design tokens in `globals.css`/`tailwind.config.ts`.

## Tests
No test suite in this repo yet. risk_class: low (new DB-backed app, first ship).

## Verification
Typecheck clean (0 errors). Production build clean — all 14 routes compiled. Live dev server: public pages (`/`, `/shop`, `/cart`, `/checkout`, `/signin`) return 200; admin/account pages correctly 307-redirect when signed out; product detail 404s only because the database was just requested this run and isn't wired into the live sandbox yet (expected — migrations run at deploy).

## How to review
Start with `scripts/migrate.mjs` (schema) and `lib/auth.ts`/`lib/session.ts` (auth flow), then the checkout → order flow in `app/api/orders/route.ts` + `lib/orders.ts`.

parsed.body:
Replaces the generic starter with a real Cake Co storefront skeleton per the PRD.

## Pages
- `/` home with occasion picker + featured cakes
- `/shop` catalog with filters
- `/cakes/[slug]` product detail + customize panel (size/flavor/filling/frosting/message)
- `/cart`, `/checkout` (pickup/delivery, date, notes — online payment noted as coming soon)
- `/orders/[id]` confirmation, `/account/orders` customer history
- `/admin` (staff-only) order status board + add/hide cakes + remove-sample-data control
- `/signin` email+password auth

## Backend
- Postgres schema (users/roles, cakes, cake_options, orders, order_items, events, invites, audit) via the append-only deploy-time migration runner
- bcrypt auth with fail-closed signed session cookies, admin gating via requireAdminPage/Route/Action
- 6 seeded sample cakes with options, flagged `is_sample` and owner-removable
- Database requested via `praxis__enable_database` (DATABASE_URL + SESSION_SECRET provisioned before publish)

## Design
Warm bakery palette (cream/terracotta), Fraunces display + Inter body, sticky header/footer, consistent card system.
parsed.title: Scaffold Cake Co ordering site: catalog, cart, checkout, orders, staff admin
parsed.customer_summary: Your cake site now has a real shop: customers can browse cakes, customize size/flavor/filling and add a message, check out with a pickup or delivery date, and see their order status. You get a staff admin to add or hide cakes and update order status. It comes pre-loaded with 6 sample cakes you can remove with one click once you add your own.
